title: Puniru is a Kawaii Slime Season 2
altTitles: Puniru is a Cute Slime Season 2
synopsis: After years of friendship with the slime girl, Puniru goes missing in the middle of training to become cuter. Meanwhile middle schooler Kotarou struggles to deal with her shape-shifting charms — and his feelings. Later, Kotarou receives an unexpected, leaky package..
